score_scale.1: Major failures; extensive manual correction required

criteria.name: Rules-text fidelity
criteria.measure: Meaningful agreement with the other sources and with manually verified published text; no silent rewriting.

criteria.name: Coverage
criteria.measure: Presence and completeness of all sampled first-party spells and their material sections.

criteria.name: Publication provenance
criteria.measure: Book, page, publisher, first-party status, and relevant FAQ or errata traceability.

criteria.name: Extraction consistency
criteria.measure: Predictable URLs and markup, clean field boundaries, and low exception count.

criteria.name: First/third-party scope control
criteria.measure: Ability to exclude third-party material and distinguish later first-party list expansions from original-book data.

criteria.name: FAQ and errata currency
criteria.measure: Presence, visibility, and traceability of official corrections rather than silent mutation.

criteria.name: Content separation
criteria.measure: Ability to exclude navigation, advertisements, artwork, comments, and unrelated content.

criteria.name: Snapshot and parser stability
criteria.measure: Repeatable parsing of archived pages and resilience to minor presentational changes.

criteria.name: Licensing and attribution clarity
criteria.measure: Ability to identify applicable notices and retain the attribution needed for the intended private prototype and any future distribution review.

mandatory_gates: No unexplained third-party content in the first-party corpus
Raw snapshots and source URLs are retained
Parser failures produce visible errors or warnings
Material fields can be traced to source observations
